PROPERTY IN HALF CONTRACT - OWNER REQUESTS NO MORE SHOWINGS. UPDATE TO PENDING SOON. VACANT - FULLY RENOVATED, 2-FAMILY - 6 BEDS - 2 BATHS - 2110 SQ. FT. - WITH FULL BASEMENT - PRIVATE DRIVEWAY - Updated Driveway And A Roof About Four Years Old.....
The Upper Floor Has Three Bedrooms And One Full Bath. The Lower Floor Has Three Bedrooms And One Full Bath. l. Full Basement Under The House For Storage And Mechanicals. Attic Space Above. Large Fully Fenced Backyard. Off-Street Parking On A Recently Rebuilt Driveway.
Built In 1915. Vinyl And Aluminum Exterior. Hot-Air Heat. Public Water. Public Sewer. No Homeowners Association. Lot About 30 Feet By 132 Feet. About 0.09 Acre. Jones Subdivision. City Of Buffalo. No Village.
Riverside Sits In Northwest Buffalo Near The Niagara River. Riverside Park Nearby, With Open Green Space, Play Areas, Sports Fields, A Pool, And An Ice Rink. 
Buffalo City School District. Nearby Schools Include P.S. 65 Roosevelt Early Childhood Center On Skillen Street, West Hertel Academy, And Riverside Academy High School On Ontario Street.
